concept_thesis: Settings as mission control. One dominant search is the primary verb; destinations are large editorial panels (title + purpose + live status), never filter chips. Workspace is a book-TOC: left vertical category index plus a continuous document with portable scrollspy and deep links. Owns the C1 manager families end-to-end and demonstrates the core surface every concept shares.

plan_owner_impacts.impact: Establishes a search-centric Settings Home (F3-432..442 range) where a dominant omni-search bar is the primary verb and destinations render as large editorial panels with title, purpose, and live status — not category pills. Introduces a book-TOC workspace: left vertical category index + continuous document. Demands that destination panels, notices, and search-result rows be first-class shell primitives rather than ad-hoc Home widgets.

Scrollspy and deep-link semantics become canonical: the left TOC highlights the active subcategory by scroll position without oscillation, and selecting a TOC entry or search result jumps to the owning section with a stable offset. This must be expressed as a portable primitive, not an IntersectionObserver-only DOM behavior.

Exercises the full setting-row grammar across the C1 families and the core provider/persona/memory rows: every value state (Default, Recommended, Inherited, Auto, Not-configured, Managed, Custom, Unavailable, Effective-differs) must be representable. Flags that several inventory values in the context/memory/persona buckets need a source/scope/effective triple rather than a bare scalar, and that exposure level (Standard/Advanced/Expert-or-risky/Managed/Diagnostic/Unavailable) is mandatory metadata, not a render-time guess.

Memory manager demonstrates evidence-backed degrading Assistant Gists: half-life changes retrieval activation only (fade, not delete), verified/unverified provenance, pin, version history + restore, capsule preview/token estimate, rebuild/dedupe/summarize/archive/redact. Requires the manager to read half-life and active-context status from the memory owner, not invent it. Automated systems use explicit thread/ledger/Goal/artifact retrieval, not hidden Gists.
plan_owner_impacts.evidence_ref: assets/demo-data.js memory gists; managers.js memory renderer

plan_owner_impacts.impact: Persona manager demonstrates behavior-not-authority: a Persona cannot grant Full Access, widen FileSafe, force a provider, or eagerly load all skills. Shows mission/use boundary, model-facing capsule preview, source/version/provenance, eligible skills, requested capabilities, and import diff with trust/secret/prompt-injection scan. Corrects stale ask/plan/regular/yolo coupling: conversation mode and access profile are separate axes.

Goal settings own defaults and ceilings only (Goal defaults, pause/resume/checkpoint policy, verification strength, sustainable fan-out, capacity reserve, worker/reviewer route classes, worktree/testing defaults) — never live run state. Runtime/Orchestrator admits actual work and reports current capacity; Settings must project requested vs effective routes without mutating live Goal state.

Crew manager demonstrates Orchestrator-owned templates with requested vs effective members + concurrency and waves. A Crew template configures purpose, member roles, persona/capability requirements, allowed provider/account/model candidates, min/max members, adaptive sizing/waves, usage/cost/time reserve, write/worktree policy, board topology, diversity/corroboration, reducer/synthesis, and failure/stop behavior. Crew is not a Persona, mode, provider, permission grant, or hidden memory.

Permissions manager demonstrates ordered last-match-wins rules, per-tool overrides, presets, read-only/full matrices, external-directory allowlist, doom-loop threshold/action, and per-Persona profiles across Global/Project/Package/Seam/Lane scope with requested/effective/origin. Requires reorder, wildcard help, and ELI5 + Expert views. Plan and Review modes remain effect-limited, not tool-free (safe read, browser, research, testing, diagnostic operations allowed).

FileSafe remains the non-bypassable floor. The manager exposes health, effective boundary, protected scopes, and repair guidance without ever encouraging or offering bypass. FileSafe status is projected as a health summary, not a toggle.

Provider/Account/Model/Installation manager renders the full object model (Provider family -> Account/Profile -> Connection -> Product/Entitlement -> Models/capabilities; Host/Environment -> Provider installation) with the 7 installation-lifecycle fixtures, requested/effective model routes, Free Models wrapper with underlying-setup flow, and catalog freshness/last-known-good fallback. Capability evidence (Fast/Normal, effort, modalities) must not be inferred from model names.

Multi-account rows show nickname, discovered identity, auth source, profile/config root, enabled state, priority, sticky-session preference, usage/quota, last successful connection/generation, health, and model visibility/favorites. Must not pretend a CLI supports simultaneous profiles when it does not; supported strategies (native profile, isolated home, auth-only profile, credential pool, PM-managed direct, single-active-login) are surfaced honestly.

Respects the CLI-owned OAuth boundary: Claude CLI and Antigravity CLI OAuth are CLI-owned (PM isolates profiles and launches the native flow; no PM-direct OAuth). PM-direct OAuth may be used for OpenAI/Codex, GitHub, GitHub Copilot. API connections remain separate from subscription/CLI products. The provider manager must not present a PM-direct OAuth control for CLI-owned routes.

Context & Instructions manager shows effective instruction sources, AGENTS.md precedence chain, source hashes + lightness warnings, last request included/omitted blocks, persona footprint, selected vs installed tools, compaction strategy, cache compatibility, retrieval caps, and a context admission receipt. The registry must not be injected into prompts merely because Settings exposes it.

Installation resolution confidence (Proven/Strongly-identified/Probable/Ambiguous/Unknown) and update states (Ready/Update-available-Ask-first/Scheduled-when-idle/Rolled-back/Could-not-identify-method/Verifying/Needs-repair/Managed-externally) are projected from the BinaryLocator owner. Unknown/ambiguous ownership is manual-only; the manager never guesses npm/Homebrew from a bare command or path shape.

Provisional settings/provider/memory/persona/crew/permission command families need adjudication against existing catalog.* and UCC-* IDs before minting canon. Retire cmd.settings.bloom.open (old chip/bloom architecture). Existing catalog.* IDs (catalog.install, catalog.update, catalog.remove, catalog.install_item, catalog.update_item, catalog.remove_item) and account/provider/usage rows must be reused rather than duplicated.

Establishes DRY component families exercised by this concept: SettingsDestination (editorial panel), SettingsNotice, SettingsWorkspaceShell, SettingsSearch, CategoryNavigation, SubcategoryScrollspy, SettingRow, ValueSourceBadge, AvailabilityReason, RequestedEffectiveInspector, ManagerShell, ResourceList, HealthSummary, SecretField, MemoryRow, PersonaCard, CrewTemplate, PermissionRuleEditor. Names are candidate design roles pending the audit agent.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: How Fast Memories Fade
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Rendered as a Memory manager control; half-life modulates retrieval activation only (fade), never truth or deletion. Must display per-kind half-life with an effective retrieval-activation badge and distinguish fade from delete in help text.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: Save Unconfirmed Notes
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Ties to the verified/unverified provenance axis. Changing this affects whether unverified Gists are persisted; the row must show the effective verify-without-evidence policy.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: Use Pinned Unconfirmed Notes
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Pinned Gists may still be unverified; this row governs whether pinned-unverified Gists enter the active context. Must carry a managed-warning when FileSafe/provenance policy overrides it.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: Memory Cleanup Tools
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Entrypoint to rebuild/dedupe/summarize/archive/redact. These are one-shot actions (ObservableWork), not persistent values; must not render as a bare toggle. Receipt + source disclosure required.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: Track Instruction Sources
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Feeds the Context manager's source-hash + lightness-warning display. Must surface AGENTS.md precedence-chain provenance, not just a boolean.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: Quarantine Broken Turns
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Governs the context admission receipt (included/omitted blocks). Requires an AvailabilityReason row when a turn is quarantined.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: Who Picks the Persona
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Must not couple to access profile or conversation mode. Behavior-not-authority: the row's help must state a Persona cannot widen FileSafe, force a provider, or grant Full Access.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: Where New Personas Live
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Scope must be one of thread/project/global (and child-only flag where applicable). Import-trust/secret/injection scan is triggered on import, not on this setting.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: Goal Mode Worker Model
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Settings owns the requested route; effective route is projected from runtime. Must render requested/effective with a fallback reason when they differ.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: Goal Mode Checker Model
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Reviewer route class; same requested/effective treatment as the worker model. Part of the defaults+ceilings surface, not live run state.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: How Often To Save Progress
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Checkpoint/compact policy default. Runtime performs the actual checkpoint; Settings only configures the default cadence and ceiling.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: Work as a Crew
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Gate for the Crew manager. Enabling Crew must not grant authority; templates remain Orchestrator-owned with requested vs effective members + concurrency.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: Agents per Crew
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Ceiling only; effective concurrency is projected from the Orchestrator at runtime. Must show requested/effective.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: Custom Permission Rules
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Ordered last-match-wins rules with reorder and per-tool overrides. Must support per-Persona profiles and the doom-loop threshold/action.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: File Protection System
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Projects FileSafe as a non-bypassable floor with health/effective-boundary/protected-scopes. Must never render as a disable control.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: Default Answer for New Tools
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Wildcard default for the ordered rule set. Must be explained with last-match-wins semantics and wildcard help.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: Show Actual Model Used
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Core surface: requested/effective model disclosure in chat. Ties to the requested/effective model route projection.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: Sign-in Method Per Provider
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Must reflect the CLI-owned vs PM-direct OAuth boundary. Claude/Antigravity CLI rows must not offer PM-direct OAuth.

settings_inventory_impacts.name: Requested Account for This Run
settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Requested axis; effective account is projected at runtime with a fallback reason.

settings_schema_impacts.impact: Settings must model 9 explicit value states (Default, Recommended, Inherited, Auto, Not-configured, Managed, Custom, Unavailable, Effective-differs). Auto/Inherit/Not-configured/Disabled must never be represented as an unexplained empty string. Every row carries default/source, scope, availability, restart/reconnect requirement, and validation/error.

Scope registry must represent turn/thread/Goal/PlanningRun/Crew/project/global/host/environment/installation/device/workspace-worktree/account/provider/Persona. Concepts show scope only when it helps the user; the full internal vocabulary belongs in Details.

Memory, Persona, Goal, Crew, Permissions, and provider/model rows need a requested/effective/origin triple rather than a scalar value. Origin records whether the effective value came from default, inheritance, managed policy, or runtime fallback.

Credentials are not ordinary text fields. Schema must distinguish PM-owned secret input, secure vault/reference selector, CLI-owned authentication, PM-owned OAuth, environment-backed secret, command-helper/vault-backed secret, and non-secret text. Reveal/copy/persist/test semantics differ by type; normal UI never exposes raw tokens.

One-shot actions (Back Up Now, Squeeze Context Now, Rebuild Memory, Verify Gist, Reconnect, Catalog Refresh), status projections (Last backup, Provider Health), diagnostics (Open backup log), persistent settings (Backup schedule, half-life), and manager routes (Backup & Restore, Memory) cannot all render as equivalent form rows. Schema must tag each row kind.

Every row carries exposure: Standard/Advanced/Expert-or-risky/Managed-read-only/Diagnostic/Unavailable. Search can find all levels; ordinary navigation does not invite users to change dangerous internals casually.

They must be adjudicated against existing shell_view/navigation_wrapper IDs and the panel-context vocabulary before minting canon.

command_id_impacts.disposition_note: value.set is a new_candidate family pending census; scope.inspect is read-only and likely reuse.

command_id_impacts.note: cmd.provider.installation.* (scan/select/install/update/repair/rollback/verify), cmd.provider.connection.* (add/authenticate/reconnect), cmd.provider.catalog.refresh, cmd.model.favorite.set / alias.set / priority.set / visibility.set. Must not duplicate account/Usage/auth/install actions.
command_id_impacts.disposition_note: Reuse catalog.install/update/remove_* for generic lifecycle; alias or supersede provider.installation.* against the CLI_Bridged_Providers owner. catalog.refresh is a new_candidate.

command_id_impacts.note: cmd.memory.* (open/verify/edit/delete/restore), cmd.persona.manage, cmd.crew.template.* (create/update/delete). memory.gist and memory.gist.* are flagged as un-cataloged owner signals that must resolve to stable command/event/storage rows or be retired.
command_id_impacts.disposition_note: Persona identity payloads must NOT use requested_persona_id/effective_persona_id (retired aliases). Crew templates are new_candidate under orchestrator-subagent-integration ownership.

command_id_impacts.note: cmd.permissions.rule.* (add/update/reorder/delete/test). Per-tool overrides and per-Persona profiles ride on the Permissions_System owner.
command_id_impacts.disposition_note: new_candidate family; must resolve /permission/config and /tool/permission registration obligations.

command_id_impacts.evidence: Old Settings chip/bloom architecture; REFERENCE_SUPERSESSIONS retires chip/bloom/no-sidebar language. Preserve a compatibility alias only if an active consumer is found; otherwise retire outright.

wiring_impacts.impact: Every manager open must trace ui_source -> command -> canonical_owner -> validation/permission -> state_mutation_or_operation -> event/receipt/ObservableWork -> ui_projection -> usage/diagnostic_attribution -> recovery/deep_link. Manager loading must NOT block the entire Settings workspace (progressive hydration).
wiring_impacts.canonical_owner_hint: ManagerShell component over owner docs (assistant-memory-subsystem / Personas / orchestrator-subagent-integration / Permissions_System).

wiring_impacts.impact: Selecting a TOC entry or search result must jump to the owning section with a stable offset and update the URL/route deep-link. The scrollspy highlight must be derived from a portable position model, not raw DOM geometry that becomes semantic state.

Verify is a one-shot action producing an ObservableWork receipt + provenance update; edit mutates Gist content with version history. Both attribute to the memory owner and emit durable events; no concept-only local state may masquerade as wiring.

Reorder mutates ordered last-match-wins rule list (revision/idempotency required); test is a one-shot dry-run returning an effective-permission projection for a sample request. FileSafe floor must remain non-bypassable across all mutations.

Refresh preserves last-known-good rows during loading and falls back on failure; reconnect returns a visible simulated/real result via the CLI-owned or PM-direct OAuth path. Both are ObservableWork with usage/diagnostic attribution.

dry_component_impacts.impact: In this concept the destination is a large editorial panel (title + purpose + live status + open affordance), proving it must carry a live status chip and purpose text, not be a bare link.
Book-TOC workspace exercises a left vertical index synced to a continuous document. Must be portable (no DOM measurement as semantic state) and oscillation-free.
Exercised by provider/model routes, Goal worker/reviewer, Crew members+concurrency, Persona capabilities, and Permissions effective result. One shared inspector shape prevents per-manager divergence.
Carries half-life/fade indicator, verified/unverified provenance badge, pin, version-history entry, and capsule token estimate. Distinct from a generic resource row.
Ordered last-match-wins list with reorder, per-tool overrides, per-Persona profiles, wildcard help, and a test/dry-run result.
Distinguishes CLI-owned auth, PM-direct OAuth, API-key, vault reference, and non-secret text. Reveal/copy/persist/test differ by type; never exposes raw tokens in normal UI.
FileSafe floor health, provider installation health, and memory rebuild status all project through one health summary shape.

schema_event_storage_impacts.impact: Memory verify/edit/pin/rebuild must emit durable events with provenance, half-life, and version. The uncataloged memory.gist / memory.gist.* signals must resolve to stable event rows or be retired. Half-life change is a retrieval-activation event, not a deletion event.
Rule add/reorder/delete/test and per-Persona profile changes must emit auditable events with revision and effective-result disclosure. FileSafe floor violations are never silently downgraded.

Installation scan/install/update/rollback/verify and catalog refresh must emit events with confidence, update-state, last-known-good fallback, and account/identity binding. Reconnect emits an auth-boundary-respecting event (CLI-owned vs PM-direct).
schema_event_storage_impacts.constraint: no PM-direct OAuth for Claude/Antigravity CLI.

schema_event_storage_impacts.impact: Persistent setting mutations emit revision/idempotency-bearing events with scope and origin. One-shot actions emit ObservableWork receipts; the two must not share a payload shape.
schema_event_storage_impacts.constraint: actions vs values separated at the storage boundary.

migration_supersession_impacts.reason: Old Settings chip/bloom/no-sidebar architecture. Superseded by search-centric Home + book-TOC workspace. Compatibility alias only if an active consumer is found.

Conversation mode and access profile are separate axes. ask/plan/regular/yolo coupling is superseded; access choices are Ask-for-approval / Auto-accept-edits / Auto / Full Access, with Plan and Review effect-limited not tool-free.
Settings now has a left Activity Bar canon and a full workspace. Right-panel-only and chip-only Settings language is superseded.

migration_supersession_impacts.invalidate: inventory values represented as bare scalars for requested/effective domains
migration_supersession_impacts.reason: Provider/model/Goal/Crew/Permission/Memory rows must carry requested/effective/origin. Bare-scalar inventory entries in these families are invalid and must migrate to the triple.

migration_supersession_impacts.retire: requested_persona_id / effective_persona_id as command payload fields
migration_supersession_impacts.reason: Retired persona/runtime identity aliases. Must not reappear as canonical command payload fields; resolve to the live persona/runtime identity contract.
PM-native Browser Program only. No Playwright runtime, facade, compatibility vocabulary, package, port, MCP, command, or capture.

slint_port_impacts.impact: Scrollspy active-section highlight must NOT be derived from raw DOM geometry that becomes semantic state. Slint has no IntersectionObserver; the position model must be portable (e.g., model-driven section index + viewport offset).
slint_port_impacts.mitigation: Compute active subcategory from a shared section-index model, not getBoundingClientRect.

slint_port_impacts.impact: Gist lists can grow large; the half-life/fade/provenance badges per row must virtualize. Slint needs a model-backed virtual list rather than DOM recycling.
slint_port_impacts.mitigation: Back MemoryRow list by a Rust model with lazy binding; avoid CSS-only infinite scroll.

slint_port_impacts.impact: Jump-to-section must settle without oscillation. CSS scroll-behavior and IntersectionObserver thresholds are not portable to Slint 1.17.1.
slint_port_impacts.mitigation: Use a single scroll driver with a debounced active-index update and a stable jump offset (PM.jumpOffset pattern).

slint_port_impacts.impact: Staggered destination/notice reveals and search-result cascades use CSS animations + nth-child delays. Must translate to Slint property animations driven by a motion reducer (respects reduced-motion).
slint_port_impacts.mitigation: motion.js install() pattern maps to a Slint motion module toggled by reduced-motion.

slint_port_impacts.impact: One backdrop blur over a pre-baked wallpaper (PMConcept7 technique). Nested backdrop-filter stacks and SVG filters are not Slint-portable.
slint_port_impacts.mitigation: Single pre-baked wallpaper layer; no nested blur.

deferred_named_owners.named_owner: Plans/storage-plan.md / Plans/Runtime_Artifacts_Panel.md (Project Home Server + physical Project Vault backbone)
deferred_named_owners.insertion_contract: The Server/Project Sync shell is reachable in this concept via shared grammar (a destination panel + manager promo) but its full surface is owned by the server-first backbone work. Insertion point: a SettingsDestination whose open affordance routes to the Server module shell once the server-first backbone ships. Until then it renders an honest unavailable state with a deep-link to the owner doc, never a fake no-op.

unresolved_questions.question: Should the book-TOC scrollspy active-index be owned by the route/open contract or by a dedicated SubcategoryScrollspy component? Affects whether deep-links are URL-first or state-first.

Does an existing canonical command cover 'manager open' (cmd.settings.manager.open), or must it be a new navigation_wrapper over route/open? Census must check cmd.project.open as the route-targeting precedent.

How should the requested/effective/origin triple be stored for Memory Gists whose half-life changes retrieval activation but not truth? Need a storage owner decision before the audit agent can finalize.
Permission rule reorder requires revision/idempotency semantics; does Permissions_System.md already define a rule-list revision contract, or is this new?
Crew template create/update/delete — are these Orchestrator-owned commands already (cmd.orchestrator.*) or genuinely new under orchestrator-subagent-integration?
